name: contact
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove output while falling (state 1); floorObj +0x7c, movableObj +0x84

name: collBox
meaning: private collision box for the fall: min (-10,-20,-10), max (10,0,10) (MineDetector_InitCollBox); flags word not written

name: homePos
meaning: spawn position (Init after snap; msg 9 arg 1 = container release); Reset returns here

name: scanSound
meaning: handle of the scanning sound 0x102; stopped by every SetState

name: reading
meaning: distance to the selected mine in world units (<= 200 shows on the gauge); INT_MAX = nothing

name: regionCount
meaning: number of registered region GroundMines (msg 0x2280, max 4); zeroed only in MineDetector_Create

name: scanning
meaning: bit 0 of the flag byte +0xb6, a one-bit field (byte bitfield operations at 0x4d828e/0x4d8418): bit 0 = scanning (set on entering state 3, cleared by msg 0x16/Reset/Init); enables the msg 0x10 carry-animation switch

name: regions
meaning: region-mode GroundMines that registered with msg 0x2280; each is asked msg 0x5a (ray distance) every scanning update
